scope: All 154 top-level messages and 23 enums in discordgo.proto; ChannelEdit is separately defined in helper.proto. Counts measure converter presence, not correctness. Parser AST comparisons are candidate omission sets: explicit zero assignments, nested inline conversions, enum semantics and deliberate runtime-only exclusions require the reviewed notes. Root currently fails compilation.

reviewedAdditionalGaps.Interaction: Context hardcoded 0; AuthorizingIntegrationOwners/Entitlements hardcoded nil; actual local Go has all three fields
reviewedAdditionalGaps.Presence.Activities: Party, Assets, Secrets, Instance, Flags omitted in inline mapping both directions
reviewedAdditionalGaps.MessageEmbed: reverse numeric enum cast yields Unicode codepoint, and forward empty Type panics
reviewedAdditionalGaps.MessageAllowedMentions: reverse enum cast yields Unicode codepoints rather than roles/users/everyone
reviewedAdditionalGaps.MessageEdit: nil versus explicit empty Content/Embeds/Attachments lost; Components rebuilt nonnil even if absent
reviewedAdditionalGaps.ApplicationCommandInteractionDataOption: role/mentionable/attachment encode absent; integer decoded to int64 conflicts with IntValue expecting float64
reviewedAdditionalGaps.ApplicationCommandInteractionDataResolve: reverse map keys rebuilt from embedded IDs; Member.User may be nil
reviewedAdditionalGaps.notWireData: Session Client/Dialer/Ratelimiter/VoiceConnections intentionally not transportable; Channel/State caches require explicit snapshot policy; User.Token must not be blindly exposed to untrusted modules
